# Silence of Nothingness

I live,
a soft whisper somewhere on a Cartesian plane -
an imaginary point,
on a projection
of God's infinite universe.

Here - at times the martyr,
at times the fool,
I flit briefly,
seemingly helplessly lost,
in the silence of nothingness -
the nothingness of now.

Yet I can know:
I am safely wrapped in His embrace.
